post.text:
The great Motability rip off grows….

Now they are giving you £750 cash back with taxpayers cash

No deposit needed 

No wonder the scam continues https://t.co/MvaA94fxfj
post.author_description: MP for Boston & Skegness | Deputy Leader & Shadow Business, Trade & Energy @reformparty_uk 🇬🇧➡️

description.description: A field of grass featuring a blue informational banner for Motability. The banner displays four different colored cars and promotional text regarding an advance payment and cashback offer. In the background, there is a red rectangular structure and a building partially visible with a 'Not Only Sofas' sign.
description.ocrText: Not Only Sofas, Motability, £NIL ADVANCE PAYMENT PLUS £750 CASHBACK
